title: Deleting an Isolation Profile for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: After creating an isolation profile for Internet & SaaS (ZIA), you can edit or delete the profile at any time.
You cannot delete default isolation profiles.
To delete an Internet & SaaS isolation profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Internet Access > Isolation Profile & Banner > Isolation Profiles.
Click the Delete icon next to the isolation profile you want to delete.
The Delete Isolation Profile window appears.
In the Delete Isolation Profile window, click Delete.

blocks.text: The page refreshes, and a temporary message appears to confirm that the isolation profile has been deleted.
